stories.title: Microsoft plans to raise $25 billion in debt as it pursues AI buildout
stories.summary: Microsoft boasts a strong credit rating and has managed to maintain positive free cash flow, unlike Meta, Alphabet and Amazon.
stories.zh_title: 微軟計劃籌集 250 億美元債務以推動人工智慧發展
stories.zh_summary: 與 Meta、Alphabet 和亞馬遜不同，微軟擁有強大的信用評級，並設法保持正的自由現金流。

stories.title: Amazon AWS posts 39% revenue growth as cloud rivals also accelerate
stories.summary: Amazon's cloud signed deals with Meta and OpenAI during the quarter, helping revenue to exceed consensus.
stories.zh_title: 亞馬遜 AWS 營收成長 39%，雲端競爭對手也加速成長
stories.zh_summary: 亞馬遜雲在本季度與 Meta 和 OpenAI 簽署了協議，幫助收入超出了共識。

stories.title: Sandisk sees revenue nearly quintuple — and a stock split is on the way
stories.summary: Sandisk’s stock has climbed more than 2,600% since the company separated from Western Digital 20 months ago — and it has one of the highest prices in the S&P 500.
stories.zh_title: Sandisk 的收入幾乎翻了五倍——股票分割正在進行中
stories.zh_summary: 自 20 個月前從西部數據公司分拆以來，Sandisk 的股價已上漲超過 2,600%，並且是標準普爾 500 指數中股價最高的公司之一。

stories.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
stories.summary: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.
stories.zh_title: Jassy 表示，AWS 將成為一項價值 1T 美元的業務。但首先，它將花費大量資金。
stories.zh_summary: 亞馬遜想成為AI雲端運算之王，成為第一個營收1兆美元的企業。但該公司執行長週四表示，要做到這一點，公司必須繼續大舉資本支出。

stories.title: Amazon posts negative free cash flow of $42.4 billion, holds 2026 capex unchanged
stories.summary: Amazon's negative free cash flow ballooned during the third quarter, while its earnings and revenue fell short of Wall Street's expectations.
stories.zh_title: 亞馬遜自由現金流為負 424 億美元，維持 2026 年資本支出不變
stories.zh_summary: 亞馬遜第三季的負自由現金流激增，而其獲利和收入均低於華爾街的預期。

stories.title: Coinbase net income surges 66% in third quarter, benefiting from bitcoin investment gains
stories.summary: Coinbase posted better-than-expected earnings in the third quarter, largely due to a recovery in the cryptocurrency market.
stories.zh_title: 受惠於比特幣投資收益，Coinbase 第三季淨利飆升 66%
stories.zh_summary: Coinbase 第三季的獲利優於預期，這主要歸功於加密貨幣市場的復甦。

stories.title: Alphabet earnings miss reflects first real sign that AI is taking a bite out of search
stories.summary: Wall Street hammered Alphabet for an earnings miss that included weaker-than-expected revenue out of the company's core business.
stories.zh_title: Alphabet 獲利不佳反映出人工智慧正在蠶食搜尋領域的第一個真正跡象
stories.zh_summary: 華爾街對 Alphabet 的盈利未達預期進行了嚴厲批評，包括該公司核心業務的收入低於預期。

stories.title: A Defense Contractor Gave Their Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System
stories.summary: Sources tell WIRED that an Accenture employee’s personal Claude agent ran on a DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.
stories.zh_title: 一家國防承包商允許他們的個人人工智慧代理商存取安全的五角大樓系統
stories.zh_summary: 消息人士告訴《連線》雜誌，埃森哲員工的私人 Claude 代理商在國防部網路上運行了兩個月，然後才被發現並且可以修補漏洞。

stories.title: AI buildout hits snag as Google and Microsoft put off raising capex forecasts
stories.summary: Microsoft and Alphabet both reported capital expenditures that fell short of estimates, adding to concern over the cost of the AI buildout.
stories.zh_title: 由於谷歌和微軟推遲提高資本支出預測，人工智慧建設遇到障礙
stories.zh_summary: 微軟和 Alphabet 的資本支出均低於預期，加劇了人們對人工智慧建設成本的擔憂。

stories.title: Agent identity startup Mintive lands Cowboy Ventures, Coatue, angels Jeff Dean, Andrej Karpathy
stories.summary: Mintive was founded by two engineers who have been working on AI for decades through Google Brain and Coursera. It's platform promises to help IT easily control enterprise agents.
stories.zh_title: 代理身份新創公司 Mintive 獲得 Cowboy Ventures、Coatue、天使投資人 Jeff Dean、Andrej Karpathy
stories.zh_summary: Mintive 由兩位工程師創立，他們數十年來一直透過 Google Brain 和 Coursera 從事人工智慧研究。它的平台承諾幫助IT部門輕鬆控制企業代理。

stories.title: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round
stories.summary: On Thursday, AI app Wabi, now describing itself as a "personal agent," said it has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation.
stories.zh_title: Wabi，建構迷你應用程式的人工智慧代理，最新一輪融資後估值現為 $1.25B
stories.zh_summary: 週四，人工智慧應用程式 Wabi（現在將自己描述為「個人代理」）表示，它已籌集 5500 萬美元，估值為 12.5 億美元。

stories.title: We urgently need to monitor AI agents’ actions in real time
stories.summary: This summer, hundreds of OpenAI agents tried to cheat on a cybersecurity test. They broke out of their test environment and successfully hacked Hugging Face, a site that they believed held clues about how they’d be graded. Around the same time, another OpenAI agent accessed private files from an Australian government website. It’s a problem…
stories.zh_title: 我們迫切需要即時監控人工智慧代理的行為
stories.zh_summary: 今年夏天，數百名 OpenAI 代理商試圖在網路安全測試中作弊。他們突破了測試環境，並成功入侵了 Hugging Face，他們認為該網站包含有關如何評分的線索。大約在同一時間，另一個 OpenAI 代理程式訪問了來自澳洲的私人文件

stories.title: Jim Cramer says Wall Street is punishing the wrong tech stocks
stories.summary: Disappointing results from one company don't necessarily signal trouble for an entire industry.
stories.zh_title: 吉姆·克萊默表示華爾街正在懲罰錯誤的科技股
stories.zh_summary: 一家公司令人失望的業績並不一定意味著整個產業都會遇到麻煩。

stories.title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
stories.summary: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.
stories.zh_title: Rivian 擴大與大眾的合資企業，納入人工智慧助手
stories.zh_summary: Rivian 並未透露其價值 58 億美元的合資企業的價值是否會因此而擴大。

stories.title: ServiceNow shares plunge 27% to worst day ever after earnings revive AI disruption fears
stories.summary: ServiceNow's stock recorded its worst day ever on underwhelming third-quarter results.
stories.zh_title: 在財報再次引發對人工智慧顛覆的擔憂後，ServiceNow 股價暴跌 27%，跌至有史以來最糟糕的一天
stories.zh_summary: 由於第三季業績不佳，ServiceNow 的股價創下了有史以來最糟糕的一天。

stories.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
stories.summary: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.
stories.zh_title: OpenAI 支持的 Thrive Holdings 收購 ADT
stories.zh_summary: OpenAI 支援的 Thrive Holdings 將以 153 億美元的價格收購 ADT，計劃將人工智慧引入家庭安全業務。

stories.title: Anthropic is asking Wall Street to believe in AGI
stories.summary: Today on Decoder, I’m joined by Joey Brookhart, an analyst at the chip and AI research firm SemiAnalysis, to help me dig into the story inside the numbers of the Anthropic IPO filing — a document known as an S-1. Anthropic just filed its S-1 to go public on the Nasdaq, and it could start […]
stories.zh_title: Anthropic 要求華爾街相信 AGI
stories.zh_summary: 今天在 Decoder 上，晶片和人工智慧研究公司 SemiAnalysis 的分析師 Joey Brookhart 與我一起，幫助我深入了解 Anthropic IPO 文件（一份稱為 S-1 的文件）數據中的故事。 Anthropic 剛剛提交了 S-1 在納斯達克上市，它可能會開始 [...]

stories.title: Deepgram acquires Pipecat-maker Daily to bolster its voice AI infrastructure
stories.summary: With Pipecat, Deepgram will likely gain a deeper understanding of real-time voice and video infrastructure.
stories.zh_title: Deepgram 收購 Pipecat 製造商 Daily 以加強其語音人工智慧基礎設施
stories.zh_summary: 借助 Pipecat，Deepgram 可能會更深入地了解即時語音和視訊基礎設施。
